map.V = 4/3·π·a·b·c（a,b,c 为三个半轴）。当 a=b=c=r 时: V = 4/3·pi·a·b·c (a,b,c are the three semi-axes). When a=b=c=r it reduces to the sphere V=4/3·pi·r3. Requires a,b,c>0.
map.例：a=3m、b=2m、c=1m → V=4/3·π·6=25.1327 m³。: Example: a=3m, b=2m, c=1m gives V=4/3·pi·6=25.1327 m3. If a=b=c=2m (a sphere), V=4/3·pi·8=33.5103 m3, exactly matching the sphere formula.

map.适用，地球近似为 a≈b（赤道半径）略大于 c（极半径）的扁椭球；代入三半轴即得: Yes; Earth is roughly an oblate spheroid with a=b (equatorial radius) slightly larger than c (polar radius). Substituting the three semi-axes gives an approximate volume, and this formula does not distinguish prolate from oblate.
